comments.react-router-dom: No 7.x release is free of advisories: `npm audit` bounces between 7.11.0 (14 SSR/redirect CVEs) and 7.18.1 (one RSC-mode CSRF issue, GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2). We track latest because it fixes all 14 and the remaining advisory only applies to RSC/framework mode, which this SPA does not use - we render a plain BrowserRouter with no loaders, actions, or server rendering.
comments.overrides: y-websocket 1.5.x declares y-leveldb, a server-only native LevelDB binding that the browser bundle never imports. Pinning it to 0.2 avoids the deprecated `leveldown` build in the client install.
